questions.question: Define main purpose of a primer in sequencing? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Define main purpose of a primer in sequencing? [U]/[CO1]
  • • A primer provides a starting site for DNA polymerase to begin synthesis during
  • sequencing. It ensures specific binding to the target region, allowing accurate
  • reading of the DNA sequence. (2 points 2 marks)
